root_cause.text: The st_lsm6dsx_hwfifo_odr_store() function indexes the odr_table array using sensor->id, but the array has only two entries (for accelerometer and gyroscope), causing an out-of-bounds access for other sensor types.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states: "calls st_lsm6dsx_check_odr(), which accesses the odr_table array at index `sensor->id`; since this array is only 2 entries long, an access for any sensor type other than accelerometer or gyroscope is an out-of-bounds access." The patch fixes this by only creating the buffer sampling frequency attribute for the accelerometer sensor (i == ST_LSM6DSX_ID_ACC), thereby preventing the vulnerable code path from being reached for other sensor types.

intent_record.intent_summary: Only expose FIFO buffer attributes for the accelerometer sensor to allow independent FIFO sampling frequency configuration.
intent_record.what: In the loop over sensors, added a local variable `attrs` that is conditionally set to `st_lsm6dsx_buffer_attrs` for the accelerometer (ST_LSM6DSX_ID_ACC) and NULL otherwise, and passed `attrs` instead of the hardcoded `st_lsm6dsx_buffer_attrs` to `devm_iio_kfifo_buffer_setup_ext`.
intent_record.how: The accelerometer device now receives the FIFO buffer attributes (e.g., for setting FIFO sampling frequency), while other sensors receive NULL attributes, preventing exposure of those attributes to other sensors.

grouping_result.intent: Only expose FIFO buffer attributes for the accelerometer sensor to allow independent FIFO sampling frequency configuration.

relevance_review.reason: The group's change restricts FIFO buffer attribute exposure to only the accelerometer sensor, which directly avoids the out-of-bounds access vulnerability in st_lsm6dsx_hwfifo_odr_store() by preventing the code from being triggered for other sensor types that would cause the array index to exceed its bounds.

candidates.rationale: This loop iterates over all sensor IDs (ST_LSM6DSX_ID_MAX), invoking FIFO buffer setup for every sensor type. Non-accelerometer/gyroscope sensors (e.g., magnetometer) then become capable of triggering st_lsm6dsx_hwfifo_odr_store(), which indexes the odr_table with sensor->id causing an out-of-bounds access since the table has only two entries.

This line explicitly registers FIFO buffer attributes for each sensor device, including those whose IDs exceed the valid range for odr_table indexing. By setting up buffers for all sensor types, it enables the vulnerable code path in st_lsm6dsx_hwfifo_odr_store() to be reached for invalid sensor IDs.
